about: Agent roster and parameters for tools/sim.py. Gauges run 0-100. baseline = long-run normal the agent drifts back to; start = state when ORACLE v2 launched (2026-10-14). sens = how strongly the agent reacts to an event's chaos / polarization / economic scores. domains = how much the agent cares about each news domain (default 1, or other_domains).

agents.name: Median swing voter
agents.description: Persuadable voter in the middle. Cares most about prices, safety and things working.

agents.name: Democratic base
agents.description: Core Democratic voters. Currently out of power and highly motivated.

agents.name: Republican base
agents.description: Core Republican voters. Loyal to the president; enthusiasm is the variable.

agents.name: Democratic leadership
agents.description: Party leaders in Congress and governors. Mobilization = willingness to confront and obstruct.

agents.name: Republican leadership & White House
agents.description: The administration and GOP congressional leaders. Mobilization = willingness to use executive power aggressively.

agents.name: Protest movement
agents.description: Organized opposition in the streets (No Kings, unions, advocacy groups).

agents.name: Pro-administration hardliners
agents.description: The most militant supporters of the administration, inside and outside government.

agents.name: Corporate & Wall Street
agents.description: Large employers, investors and lobbies. Anger = market stress; they push hardest for oil relief and against chaos.

agents.name: Federal Reserve
agents.description: Technocratic central bank. Mobilization = readiness to tighten policy.

agents.name: Federal courts
agents.description: Judges and the Supreme Court. Mobilization = readiness to block or check the executive.

agents.name: Iran & allied forces
agents.description: Iran's leadership, the IRGC and allied groups such as the Houthis. Mobilization = readiness to escalate.
